description_en:
Xianyan provides you with OpenAPI operations that deliver the same conversational experience as the official console. By simply passing parameters such as workspaceId and query, you can perform Q&A and data analytics on your pre-created workspace.

This API operation is suitable for the following scenario:  
You have associated a data source in the Xianyan console, allowing Xianyan to access your database and execute SQL queries either over the Internet or through a VPC.

For detailed usage instructions, refer to the following Best Practices document:  
https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/gbi-best-practices
description_zh:
析言为您提供了与官方页面对话效果相同的OpenAPI接口，只需传入workspaceId以及query等相关信息，即可对您已经创建好的业务空间进行问答和数据分析。

该接口适合以下场景：
您在析言控制台关联了数据源，即析言可以通过公网或者VPC的方式访问您的数据库并执行SQL。

具体的使用，可以参考以下最佳实践文档：
https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/gbi-best-practices
name: RunDataAnalysis

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud Model Studio workspace ID used for the current request
parameters.help_zh: 当前请求所使用的阿里云百炼业务空间id
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: Custom parameters passed through by the current conversation API. Currently supported options include: skip rewriting, skip visualization module, and enable question clarification in conversations
parameters.help_zh: 当前对话接口所透传的自定义参数，现仅支持：跳过改写、跳过可视化模块、开启对话问题澄清
parameters.name: agent_ctrl_params

parameters.help_en:
A list of database permission role names.  
You must configure the relevant database permission settings on the product page before you can obtain and invoke these parameters in the API
parameters.help_zh:
数据权限-角色名称的列表
数据权限的相关配置内容需要在产品页面进行配置后，方可获取参数在api中调用
parameters.name: data_role

parameters.help_en: The current request only generates and returns SQL without executing it
parameters.help_zh: 当前请求只生成并返回sql，不会执行
parameters.name: generate_sql_only

parameters.example: 请问销量前十的产品有哪些
parameters.help_en: The query input by the user
parameters.name: query

parameters.help_en: The message session ID returned in the service window callback message
parameters.help_zh: 消息会话ID，服务窗回调消息返回的会话ID
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: The version to use for the current request. If not specified, the default workspace version is used
parameters.help_zh: 当前请求指定使用的版本信息，不填时使用默认业务空间版本
parameters.name: specification_type

parameters.help_en:
Custom parameters on which the data role depends. If the role is configured with external parameters, these must be provided.  
You must configure the relevant database permission settings on the product page before you can obtain and invoke these parameters in the API
parameters.help_zh:
数据角色依赖的自定义参数，当该角色配置了外部参数，必须传入
数据权限的相关配置内容需要在产品页面进行配置后，方可获取参数在api中调用
parameters.name: user_params

code.description_en: Error code exposed by the system for troubleshooting purposes; no action is required from the user.
code.description_zh: 系统错误透出的错误码，用于报错排查，无需用户处理

attempts.description_en: Event field output when SQL validation is enabled, containing the SQL generated in each retry attempt and the corresponding error reason
attempts.description_zh: 开启sql校验时会输出的事件类型字段，包含每轮重试生成的sql以及报错原因

items.description_en: The specific SQL and detailed error information generated in each retry attempt
items.description_zh: 每伦重试生成的具体sql、具体的报错信息
items.example: [{"sql":"SHOW TABLES","sqlError":"sql is invalid"},{"sql":"SHOW TABLES;","sqlError":"sql is invalid"}]

chat.description_en: Clarification event. This event occurs when the user's query is ambiguous and the clarification toggle is enabled
chat.description_zh: 澄清事件，当用户问题较模糊并开启了需要澄清的开关时产生的事件

text.description_en: Clarification wording. When the model determines that the user's current query does not match the associated data content, it generates a follow-up question to help the user confirm their intent
text.description_zh: 澄清话术，模型判断当前用户问题与当前关联数据内容信息不匹配时所产生的反问话术，帮助用户确认问题内容
text.example: 您想查询的是订单表的创建时间字段嘛？

errorMessage.example: Access was denied, message: No such namespace namespaces/tech-scp-chain7.

evidence.description_en: Information used to assist model inference
evidence.description_zh: 所用到的辅助模型推理的信息

httpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code exposed by the current round of events. It is not normally exposed and does not require handling
httpStatusCode.description_zh: 当前某一轮事件透出的http状态码，正常情况下不会额外透出，无需处理

requestId.description_en: The ID of the current request

rewrite.example: 查询全部关键字数据，并以饼图形式展示

selector.description_en: The tables retrieved in this conversation for SQL generation
selector.description_zh: 这次对话，召回了哪些表以用于sql的生成

items.description_en: The name of the specific table used in retrieval
items.description_zh: 召回的具体的表的名字

sql.description_en: The SQL statement generated for the current conversation
sql.example: select p.product_id, p.product_name, sum(o.quantity) as total_sales from products p join orders o on p.product_id = o.product_id where o.order_date between '2022-10-22' and '2024-10-22' group by p.product_id, p.product_name having total_sales > 5

sqlData.description_en: Structured content returned by SQL execution
sqlData.description_zh: sql执行所返回的结构化内容

column.description_en: The specific field names in the SQL execution result
column.description_zh: sql执行结果中，查询的具体的字段名字

data.description_en: Structured data obtained after SQL execution, which may contain multiple records
data.description_zh: sql执行后获取的结构化数据，可能是多条

items.description_en: A row of structured data retrieved after executing the SQL statement
items.description_zh: sql执行后所查询到的结构化数据的一条内容

sqlError.description_en: When task execution failed, this field contains the error message explaining the cause of the failure
sqlError.description_zh: 当任务执行失败时，此字段会报错导致任务失败的原因
sqlError.example: Can not issue data manipulation statements with executeQuery()

visualization.description_en: Information required for visualization module display
visualization.description_zh: 用于可视化模块展示所需要的信息

data.description_en: Structured information used for visualization module display
data.description_zh: 用于可视化模块展示的结构化信息

option.description_en: Configuration information required to initialize the frontend widget. This field is valid only when chartsFramework=echarts in the input parameter agentCtrlParams.
option.description_zh: 初始化前端组件所需要的配置信息。仅当入参agentCtrlParams中chartsFramework=echarts时，该字段才有效

plotType.description_en: Type of visualization chart to display
plotType.description_zh: 可视化图表展示的类型

stack.description_en: Whether to display the column chart in stacking mode. This parameter is valid only when the chart type is a column chart.
stack.description_zh: 是否以堆叠的方式展示柱状图。仅当图表类型是柱状图的情况下，该参数才有效

xAxis.description_en: The content of the x-axis in the visualization chart
xAxis.description_zh: 可视化图表中x轴的内容

items.description_en: The field displayed on a specific x-axis
items.description_zh: 具体某一个x轴所展示的字段

yAxis.description_en: Content of the y-axis in the visualization chart
yAxis.description_zh: 可视化图表中y轴的内容

items.description_zh: 具体某一个y轴所展示的字段

httpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code exposed by the current request. It is not normally exposed and does not require handling
